name: SHIITAKE
blurb: EASY TO FRUIT, HARD TO INCUBATE. ABOUT 12 WEEKS.

overview.v: Easiest to fruit, hardest to incubate: roughly half the skill is incubation.
6-14 weeks incubation. Needs roughly 5-10 times the incubation space of fast species.
LE3790 (Mycelia, Japanese origin). Sibling 3782 has smaller, thinner caps. Others: 321, Straw, JC, KOM.
Several farms quit or call it their least profitable species: lots of space, time and cooling.
Low, ideally a separate room. Never above lion's mane: brown exudate stains white fruit.

cultivation.v: 70% red oak sawdust, 30% wheat (ground wheat, mids or bran), water only.
Cap n Stem ultra-pasteurizes: 96-99 °C for 3 h.
Shiitake does better sterilized or by quasi-pressure cook. Trial both if you have a pressure vessel.
Unicorn A patch, designed for shiitake.

timeline.v: About 12 weeks at Cap n Stem: colonize weeks 1-4, popcorn and buckle 5-8, brown 7-12. Range 6-14 weeks by strain.
At least 75-80% browned. "120% brown" gives more, smaller mushrooms.
Pins within about 2 days. Harvest 6-8 days from stripping.

climate.v: 19 °C room. Core runs 2-3 °C hotter. Keep the core at or below about 23 °C.
Ideal about 2,500 ppm, maximum 5,000. About 500 ppm gave patchy dried blocks.
6,500 K full spectrum, bright enough to see into the rack centre. Needed for buckling and browning.
Strain 3790: 10-16 °C, about 13 °C. A cold shock delays pinning.

yield_.v: 3782 on 5 lb blocks: 1 lb or more. Straw: about 1 lb.
Caps picked late and flat have terrible quality and shelf life.

hazards.v: Blocks buckle and brown but never fruit; heat stress. Hold cores at or below about 23 °C.
Air pockets under the skin from temperature swings.
A week of harvesting 3782 gave several staff spore lung. Wear a respirator.

notes.v: Hold incubation at 19 °C with steady light and gentle air on all sides of every block.
Use data loggers inside a block to see real core temperatures.
